title: The Cyber Cooperative CTF
description:
Do you like participating in CTFs? Practicing and levelling up your skills to complete said challenges? 

If you said yes to any of those, join us in the Cyber Cooperative's first-ever large Capture the Flag competition! 

We are gladly sponsored by Tenable.

This will be a global competition to put your security skills to the test in a series of challenges across a variety of categories including web security, foresnics, reverse engineering and cryptography, and you can compete as an individual or in a team of up to 5 people!

The event will go LIVE on December 15th at 12:01 am and end December 17th at 11:59pm - Eastern Time (US). 

To chat with fellow participants, join our Discord - https://discord.gg/9yPVMVDwgV - to join our community of cybersecurity students, professionals, and enthusiasts in the Cyber Cooperative.
prizes:
Top 50: Programmer socks (Yes, those programmer socks. Color choice can be yours!)

Top 10: The above + Cyber Cooperative T-shirt 

Top 3:
#3 : The above + rubber ducks of choice (literally sooo many options. Including the glow in the dark ducks that come with like, 200).
#2 : The above + Yubikey 5 of choice (5 or 5c)
#1 : The above + custom neon sign for your ~ set up ~
